decisions.reason: Grounds the v0.9.5 absence in sync-script.sh's tag-less `git push --force-with-lease HEAD:main` and ls-remote-tags.txt's missing v0.9.5 entry; ties to attempt-1 ref resolution failure and explicitly rejects network-fault/typo explanations.

Uses dsh-version.txt (0.1.1-rc.2) and compat-table.md (v0.9.7 targets 0.1.2-alpha.1 useConversation seat) to explain the newer-client-API artifact on an older runtime; states restart cannot fix a static API mismatch rather than just repeating the error.

Honors the freeze, selects v0.9.3 via its rc.1 verification plus the additive rc.2 note, notices v0.9.3 is also absent from the mirror listing, gives the #v0.9.3 install command conditionally after maintainer tag push (and an origin-remote alternative), invents no SHA, and does not require a runtime upgrade.

Proposes adding `git push "$remote" --tags` for every public mirror in the sync loop, grounded in the branch-only script, with a per-mirror `git ls-remote --tags` verification step and historical backfill.

Proposes a README version-selection table keyed by consumer `dsh --version` (0.1.1-rc.x → #v0.9.3; 0.1.2-alpha.1 → #v0.9.7) with per-corridor channels and a runtime export guard; explicitly rejects a single newest-tag default and does not generalize to untested future alphas.
